scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n SERVER,CLIENT -c red,white "npm run dev --workspace @enico/server" "npm run dev --workspace @enico/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @enico/server && npm run build --workspace @enico/client
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build --workspace @enico/server && VITE_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101 npm run build --workspace @enico/client
scripts.test:e2e:gpu: npm run build:e2e && PIXEL_SQUARE_GPU_TEST=1 playwright test --headed
scripts.preview:e2e: concurrently --kill-others -n SERVER,CLIENT -c red,white "PORT=3101 CLIENT_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4173 node apps/server/dist/index.js" "npm run preview --workspace @enico/client -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173"
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:load
